svg.title: Larson clinches a third NASCAR Cup title
svg.desc: Editorial illustration of Homestead-Miami Speedway on a bright afternoon. In the foreground, two crew leaders in headsets throw their arms up on top of a tall coral-and-navy pit box. Beyond them the field circles in single file behind a yellow pace car under caution, with a white No. 5 car mid-pack, glowing. Yellow radio waves arc from the pit-box antenna to that car, showing Kyle Larson's third Cup Series championship clinched at the end of Stage 1 on Nov. 8, 2026. Palm trees and grandstands line the far side.
